text:
olga: starting overnight handoff — quick recap:
olga: seeing a ~2x embed QPS spike in us-east-1 around 02:10 UTC. KV cache miss rate up ~18%, p95 latency jumped ~120ms -> ~380ms. dedicated-pool-3 queue depth increased; autoscaler scaled 1->3 but two pods briefly hit ImagePullBackOff (fixed). no customer-facing 5xx increase observed.
maria: link to dashboards?
olga: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/embed-qps  logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/trace/xyz (will paste specific panels in thread)
ajay: I restarted the kvcache sidecar on one pod a few minutes ago — that host's miss rate dropped ~5%. my plan: do a canary rolling-restart of pool-3 (one pod at a time). any objections? :thumbsup:/:-1:
devon: there's also PR #7812 to bump imagePull timeout in the infra chart (needs reviewer), might reduce transient pull failures. pinging @maria for review.
maria: ack — I'll take a look in ~20m. If canary looks good go ahead with roll; prefer one-by-one so token caches warm.
ajay: executing canary now, will run this command on the canary pod:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart sts/dedicated-pool-3 --selector=role=canary
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started for dedicated-pool-3/canary -> pod/dedicated-pool-3-canary-1 (ts 1869991400)
olga: canary restart finished, metrics show improvement: p95 ~180ms, kvcache miss down ~9% vs spike. continuing to monitor for 30m.
ajay: action items for this shift: [1] roll remaining pool-3 pods after 10m stable canary; [2] open ticket to trace QPS spike origin (possible client retry loop). I'll create ticket and assign to @devon.
devon: will check client-side logs and routing config around 02:00-02:20 UTC, also inspect ingress throttles.
maria: no other active incidents. set alert: p95 > 250ms for us-east-1 with 30s eval. if we see regression escalate to SEV2.
olga: handing off to ajay — last check: no elevated 5xx, rate limits holding, autoscaler healthy. please ping in #eng-oncall if anything changes. thanks all! :pray:
ajay: taking it from here — I'll post a follow-up thread if we need a full pool rollback or customer-impacting mitigation.
